Trivariate density isosurfaces

Source: R/layers-stats-volumes.R
stat_density_3d.Rd

Evaluates an axis-aligned Gaussian product kernel on transformed x/y/z scale ranges. h contains Gaussian standard deviations in transformed units. Automatic bandwidths use normal-reference marginal bandwidths with sample size exponent -1/7. adjust multiplies automatic bandwidths. Numeric levels are density thresholds; probs() specifies absolute enclosed probability contents estimated by tensor trapezoidal quadrature. Computed level and density contain the resolved density threshold.

Usage

stat_density_3d(
  mapping = NULL,
  data = NULL,
  geom = GeomStatsSurface3D,
  position = "identity",
  ...,
  h = NULL,
  adjust = 1,
  n = 32L,
  levels = NULL,
  caps = FALSE,
  na.rm = FALSE,
  show.legend = NA,
  inherit.aes = TRUE
)

geom_isodensity_3d(...)

Arguments

mapping, data, position, ..., na.rm, show.legend, inherit.aes

Standard layer arguments.

geom

Geom prototype for keyed triangle corners.

h

Positive bandwidth, scalar or one per axis; NULL estimates it.

adjust

Positive automatic bandwidth multiplier, scalar or one per axis.

n

Grid resolution, scalar or three integers.

levels

Numeric scalar-field thresholds; NULL uses pretty levels.

caps

Whether to cap the sublevel region on the box faces.

Examples

set.seed(1)
d <- data.frame(x = rnorm(80), y = rnorm(80), z = rnorm(80))
ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(x, y, z = z)) +
  geom_isodensity_3d(h = 0.6, levels = 0.02, n = 12) + coord_3d()
ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(x, y, z = z)) +
  stat_density_3d(h = 0.6, levels = 0.02, n = 8) + coord_3d()
